title: An astonishing old calculator - Numberphile
summary: Cliff Stoll shows and explains his two Friden EC-132 electronic calculators for Numberphile. The video covers how these early machines worked, including their unusual acoustic delay line memory.
why: It is the go-to visual explanation of delay-line memory and early electronic calculators whenever the topic comes up.

quote.text: There is also a fantastic video where Cliff Stoll describes the Friden EC-132 calculator and shows off its acoustic delay line here
